post.description: Download a multiple documents in one pdf file.
Creates documents for orders. Documents can for example be an invoice or a delivery note.

parameters.name: documentTypeName
parameters.description: The type of document to create

type.description: Type of the document to be generated.

fileType.description: Type of document file to be generated.

static.description: Indicate if the document should be static or not.

config.description: Document specific configuration, like documentNumber, documentDate, documentComment.

200.description: Documents created successfully. The `api/_action/order/document/create` route can be used to download the document.

get.summary: List supported document V2 types and formats
get.description: Returns document types and output formats currently implemented by the Document V2 pipeline. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

200.description: Supported document types and their available formats.

documentTypes.description: Map of supported document type technical names to the formats implemented for that document type. Use these values for the `documentType`, `formats`, and `format` fields of the create, preview, and upload endpoints.

formats.description: Supported file format technical names for this document type.

post.summary: Create a document through the Document V2 pipeline
post.description: Creates one document with one or more requested output formats using the Document V2 services. Get supported `documentType` and `formats` values from `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`. Use the returned `documentId` and one of the returned `formats` to download the created file through `/_action/order/document-v2/{documentId}/download/{format}`. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order for which the document should be created.

documentType.description: Document type technical name. Must be one of the keys returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

formats.description: File format technical names to generate. Must be selected from `documentTypes[documentType].formats` returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

documentNumber.description: Optional document number. When omitted, the Document V2 service generates the next number.

documentDate.description: Optional document date as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

deliveryDate.description: Optional delivery date as an ISO 8601 date-time string. Required by the `delivery_note` document type.

referencedDocumentId.description: Optional identifier of the referenced document. When omitted, the order's latest invoice is used.

200.description: Document created successfully. Use `documentId` and one of the returned `formats` to download the created file through `/_action/order/document-v2/{documentId}/download/{format}`.

deepLinkCode.description: A unique hash code which is required to download the generated document.

formats.description: The generated formats. Use one of these values as the `format` path parameter when downloading the document.

post.summary: Upload a document through the Document V2 pipeline
post.description: Creates one static Document V2 document from either an existing media file or a raw binary file upload. Use `application/json` when the file already exists as media and pass `mediaId` in the body. Use a binary request body when uploading file bytes directly; in that case pass the document metadata as query parameters. Example binary upload: `POST /_action/order/document-v2/upload?orderId=018f5972f9ea72a0be49f7c39f72a2a0&orderVersionId=0fa91ce3e96a4bc2be4bd9ce752c3425&documentType=invoice&format=pdf&extension=pdf&fileName=invoice-1002` with header `Content-Type: application/pdf` and the PDF bytes as the request body. Get supported `documentType` and `format` values from `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads. Identifier of the order for which the uploaded document should be created. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: orderVersionId
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads. Version identifier of the order for which the uploaded document should be created. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: documentType
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads. Document type technical name. Must be one of the keys returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads. Document file format to store. Must be selected from `documentTypes[documentType].formats` returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: extension
parameters.description: Required for binary uploads. File extension of the uploaded binary body, without a leading dot. Usually this is the same value as `format`.

parameters.name: fileName
parameters.description: Optional for binary uploads. Preferred stored media filename without the extension. If omitted, the document number or a generated identifier is used.

parameters.name: referencedDocumentId
parameters.description: Optional for binary uploads. Identifier of the referenced document. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: documentNumber
parameters.description: Optional for binary uploads. Document number stored in the document configuration. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: documentComment
parameters.description: Optional for binary uploads. Document comment stored in the document configuration. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

parameters.name: documentDate
parameters.description: Optional for binary uploads. Document date stored in the document configuration as an ISO 8601 date-time string. For JSON uploads, send this field in the request body instead.

requestBody.description: Use `application/json` to attach an existing media file by `mediaId`. Use a binary media type, for example `application/pdf`, to upload file bytes directly and provide the document metadata through query parameters. For binary uploads, the body is the raw file content, not JSON.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order for which the uploaded document should be created.

orderVersionId.description: Version identifier of the order for which the uploaded document should be created.

documentType.description: Document type technical name. Must be one of the keys returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

format.description: File format technical name. Must be selected from `documentTypes[documentType].formats` returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

mediaId.description: Identifier of an existing media file to attach to the document. Required for JSON uploads.

referencedDocumentId.description: Optional identifier of the referenced document.

documentDate.description: Optional document date as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

schema.description: Raw file bytes. For binary uploads, send the required document metadata as query parameters.
Raw file bytes. For binary uploads, send the required document metadata as query parameters.

200.description: Document uploaded successfully. Use `documentId` and one of the returned `formats` to download the uploaded file through `/_action/order/document-v2/{documentId}/download/{format}`.

deepLinkCode.description: A unique hash code which is required to download the uploaded document.

formats.description: The uploaded format. Use one of these values as the `format` path parameter when downloading the document.

get.description: Downloads one persisted format for a Document V2 document. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

post.summary: Download one or more Document V2 documents as ZIP
post.description: Downloads all persisted formats for the requested Document V2 documents as one ZIP archive. The archive contains one file per persisted format per document, and additionally includes the media of documents that were created by document generation v1. Entries are named `{orderNumber}_{fileName}.{extension}` to avoid collisions across documents. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

documentIds.description: Identifiers of the documents to include in the archive. At most 100 per request.

200.description: A ZIP archive containing all persisted files for the requested documents.

post.summary: Preview a document through the Document V2 pipeline
post.description: Renders one requested output format through the Document V2 services without persisting the document. Get supported `documentType` and `format` values from `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`. The response `Content-Type` depends on the requested format. Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

orderId.description: Identifier of the order for which the document should be previewed.

documentType.description: Document type technical name. Must be one of the keys returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

format.description: File format technical name to preview. Must be selected from `documentTypes[documentType].formats` returned by `/_action/order/document-v2/available-types`.

documentNumber.description: Optional document number to render in the preview.

documentComment.description: Optional document comment to render in the preview.

documentDate.description: Optional document date as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

deliveryDate.description: Optional delivery date as an ISO 8601 date-time string. Required by the `delivery_note` document type.

referencedDocumentId.description: Optional identifier of the referenced document. When omitted, the order's latest invoice is used.

post.summary: Transition an order to a new state
post.description: Changes the order state and informs the customer via email if configured.

parameters.name: transition
parameters.description:
The `action_name` of the `state_machine_transition`. For example `process` if the order state should change from open to in progress.

Note: If you choose a transition that is not available, you will get an error that lists possible transitions for the current state.

sendMail.description: Controls if a mail should be sent to the customer.

documentIds.description: A list of document identifiers that should be attached

mediaIds.description: A list of media identifiers that should be attached

stateFieldName.description: This is the state column within the order database table. There should be no need to change it from the default.

internalComment.description: An optional internal comment that will be saved with the state transition.
